data.description:
Audit the running UI against BRANDING.md and the reference demo, and fix every deviation that is a frontend bug rather than a design change. Design: BRANDING.md in full, with special attention to §2.2 (the five oxblood jobs), §3.3 (type rules), §4 (shell and breakpoints), §5 (every component), §6 (motion), §7 (copy and formatting), §8 (don'ts). Reference: docs/branding-demo.html. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §13 for known engineering deltas.

Why: three component tasks and a wiring task were built in parallel by different agents; this pass is the one place the whole surface is checked as one system by fresh eyes before the README and packaging.

Scope:
- With api and web running, compare each component to the demo at a width above 760px and at or below 760px.
- Checklist, each recorded pass or fixed in a task comment: oxblood appears only in the five §2.2 jobs; no radius except the rank pill; no shadows, gradients, translucency, icons, images; Bodoni never below 18px; tabular figures where digits sit in columns; uppercase only in labels and the wordmark; every §7.2 string verbatim; every §7.1 format; the document never scrolls; pinned header, filter bar, status line and pager; loading line is the only animation and is static under reduced motion; disabled looks use ink-3 and stone, not opacity; keyboard-only pass through search, pagination and Try again; `grep -rP "[\x{1F300}-\x{1FAFF}\x{2600}-\x{27BF}]"` over the repo finds nothing.
- Fix small CSS, markup and copy deviations in place. Anything that would require changing BRANDING.md itself (for example the Status field row, SPEC §13.1) is not changed here: raise it with `lattice needs-human` naming the section.

Acceptance:
- A checklist comment on the task listing every BRANDING section with pass or fixed.
- Screenshots at both breakpoints for the default search, the no-results state, the invalid-input state and the error state, attached to the task.
- `make check` still green.

Validation: the screenshots and the keyboard pass are the evidence; attach with --role validation.
data.title: Branding conformance pass: audit UI against BRANDING.md and the demo, fix deviations

data.body:
From BC-10 (review + validation), polish candidates for the branding pass, none blocking:
1. docs/branding-demo.html has no <meta charset>; opened as file:// the ' · ' separators render as 'Â·' (fine over HTTP). Branding owner's file (BRANDING 9 process).
2. At 375px the card meta line can break inside an item (e.g. '980 / sqft'), same as the demo; a no-break space inside each meta item would keep items whole. BRANDING is silent.
3. Text-button recipe exists in two textual forms: NoResults/ErrorState .action use 'font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-ui)' (R1 recipe verbatim), Pager uses --text-button/--leading-button tokens; identical computed values. Pick one form or hoist a shared class. BC-9's .clear still carries --tracking-button and an :active colour per BC-10's implementer (unverified by BC-10).
4. Monogram height is a literal 54px next to var(--monogram-width); calc(var(--monogram-width) * 3 / 4) would tie the 4:3 ratio to the token.
5. Open D1: at <=760px the demo shrinks the monogram (56x42 at 20px) and type and puts the price after the description; BC-10 follows BRANDING text (72x54, same sizes, price block under the meta line). Reconcile demo vs BRANDING via BRANDING 9 if the demo was intended.

From BC-12 plan review (handed over for the branding/a11y pass): (a) during a page-change load the StatusLine still reads the previous 'Page 1 of N' while the Pager already marks the clicked page (one request long; SearchPage feeds Pager the URL page). (b) SearchPage's results <main> is aria-live=polite + aria-busy (so NoResults/ErrorState are announced); ListingList's <section> is also aria-live=polite, giving nested polite regions. Consider dropping aria-live from ListingList's section. (c) BRANDING §5.9 'first load = status line alone' vs SPEC §7.5 LoadingLine active while loading: BC-12 keeps the LoadingLine on during the first load.

From BC-12 validation (art_01M4WC9P46N4142PWSVQ1JMF0J, item 7): when the results region scrolls, cards cut off flush against the StatusLine row with no divider or fade. Check against BRANDING §4.2 / the demo whether the status row should carry a hairline or the scroller a top fade.

From BC-12 implementation: frontend/src/components/FilterBar/FilterBar.module.css has a comment calling the bar 'a direct child of the shell'; since BC-12 it sits inside SearchPage's unstyled row-2 wrapper (with LoadingLine). Comment-only fix, left untouched by BC-12 (component files were out of scope).
